description: A URL server that answers 401 to initialize and no credential is configured. Pins Rust McpPool::note_connect_failure / error_needs_oauth_login / to_api_tools: boot reports the rejection with the /mcp login recovery, the server lands in the needs-auth state, the catalog offers exactly the synthetic mcp_<server>_authenticate tool, and a call to one of the server's real tool names fails with the auth-required hint instead of a bare unknown-tool error. Only unauthenticated initialize POSTs reach the server (the summary does not pin how many connect attempts the call makes).
